description:
List the enriched SpiderGate model catalog: identity + spec + authored copy + benchmarks + per-provider price/latency + reference links + evals aggregate, with provenance on every sourced field.
Use "fields" (CSV) to narrow the payload for concrete-model selection, e.g. fields="capabilities,pricing,per_provider,evals" — recognised sections: capabilities, context, max_output, pricing, tier, descriptions, tags, aliases, per_provider, benchmarks, links, evals. Read-only, not metered.

include_hidden.description: Include models hidden from the public catalog.

name: gate_catalog_list
